issue.title: Raise error when blueprint name contains a dot
issue.body: Blueprints cannot have a dot in their name because the dot is used to separate the blueprint name and endpoint in url_for. Currently, Blueprint allows dots in names which later leads to confusing errors.

args.title: Raise ValueError when blueprint name contains a dot
args.body:
Fixes the issue where Blueprint allowed dots in names, leading to confusing errors when using url_for.

## Changes
- Added a validation check in `Blueprint.__init__` that raises `ValueError` if the name contains a dot character.

## Testing
- `tests/test_blueprints.py::test_dotted_name_not_allowed` now passes.
